mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (auction_id, buyer_id, seller_id, final_price, status) VALUES (#{auctionId}, #{buyerId}, #{sellerId}, #{finalPrice}, 'pending')
mapper.select: SELECT o.*, a.ticket_id AS ticket_id, t.event_name AS ticket_event_name, seller.username AS seller_username, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM review r WHERE r.order_id = o.id AND r.reviewer_id = o.buyer_id) AS review_left FROM orders o JOIN auction a ON a.id = o.auction_id JOIN ticket t ON t.id = a.ticket_id JOIN user seller ON seller.id = o.seller_id WHERE o.id = #{id}

SELECT o.*, a.ticket_id AS ticket_id, t.event_name AS ticket_event_name, seller.username AS seller_username, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM review r WHERE r.order_id = o.id AND r.reviewer_id = o.buyer_id) AS review_left FROM orders o JOIN auction a ON a.id = o.auction_id JOIN ticket t ON t.id = a.ticket_id JOIN user seller ON seller.id = o.seller_id WHERE o.auction_id = #{auctionId}

SELECT o.*, a.ticket_id AS ticket_id, t.event_name AS ticket_event_name, seller.username AS seller_username, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM review r WHERE r.order_id = o.id AND r.reviewer_id = o.buyer_id) AS review_left FROM orders o JOIN auction a ON a.id = o.auction_id JOIN ticket t ON t.id = a.ticket_id JOIN user seller ON seller.id = o.seller_id WHERE o.buyer_id = #{buyerId} ORDER BY o.create_time DESC

SELECT o.*, a.ticket_id AS ticket_id, t.event_name AS ticket_event_name, seller.username AS seller_username, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM review r WHERE r.order_id = o.id AND r.reviewer_id = o.buyer_id) AS review_left FROM orders o JOIN auction a ON a.id = o.auction_id JOIN ticket t ON t.id = a.ticket_id JOIN user seller ON seller.id = o.seller_id WHERE o.seller_id = #{sellerId} ORDER BY o.create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
